description: Fork of exp151 (DominanceCanonicalize on qk_lut, d_head=32, 279M, +0.020 behind exp144 at step 1600). Single change: drop the LayerNorm inside DominanceCanonicalize. Build the canonicalize chain manually as DominanceToVector(d_head=32, normalise=False) -> VectorToDominance(d_head=32, smooth_mode=False). Hypothesis: with LN, V2D's pair-diff |a-b| is normalized to ~√2 throughout training (>>τ=0.1) so STE soft gradient ≈ τ/(τ+1.4)² ≈ 0.045 — saturated regime always. Without LN, raw Borda magnitude scales with input dominance (small at init, ~4 at convergence), giving the natural 'linear-at-init → saturated-at-end' STE curriculum (gradient amp ~10 at init dropping to ~0 at convergence). exp144's qk path also has no LN before V2D — restoring this should match exp144's gradient flow while keeping exp151's wider qk_lut emission space.
